solution_text: For z = a + bi, |z| = sqrt(a^2+b^2). Hence |3+4i| = sqrt(9+16) = 5.
tips: Treat the real and imaginary parts as perpendicular components.

solution_text: Differentiate f(x) = x^3 - 3x to get f'(x) = 3x^2 - 3. At x = 2, f'(2) = 12 - 3 = 9.
tips: Differentiate first, then substitute the required value.
